name: Fairy Stream
kicker: Ankle-deep walk under the sand hills
summary: Shallow stream under the sand hills: walk it barefoot in ankle-deep water for the red clay bank. Suối Tiên is the name on the Binh Thuan feature. Suối Hồng is the name on the coast page. Take your shoes off and walk upstream, with red clay and limestone on one side and forest or coconut trees on the other. A rest stop has a cool coconut. This is the pause between the strip and the dunes.
getThere: A stop under the sand hills, off the Ham Tien strip.
heroCaption: Walkers in the stream, red clay on one side and palms on the other

notice.title: Shoes off
notice.body: The water is ankle-deep. Walk upstream and stop for a coconut.

body: Take your shoes off and walk upstream. The water is ankle-deep. Red clay and limestone rise on one side. The must-do page puts forest on the other. The Binh Thuan feature puts coconut trees there. A rest stop along the walk sells a cool coconut.

The coast page also calls this Suối Hồng, the fairy stream, between white stalactite hills. The Binh Thuan feature calls it Suối Tiên and places it under the Mui Ne sand hills. Give it a daytime pause. The dunes are the longer rides.

figures.caption: Red and white clay along the shallow stream
figures.alt: Red and pale clay banks beside the Fairy Stream at Mui Ne

gettingThere: The stream sits under the Mui Ne sand hills, a stop from the Ham Tien strip. The Binh Thuan feature places Suối Tiên there. The coast page uses the name Suối Hồng for the same walk.

legs.heading: From the Ham Tien strip
legs.body: A stop inland from the beach strip, under the sand hills. Vietnam Tourism pairs the stream with the dunes and the coast.

admissionNote: The visit is the barefoot walk. A coconut at a rest stop is the named pause.
